Our most popular option for quality and maximum organization is the 222x2x11 3-Drawer Pull-Out Spice Rack.
It features three independent full-extension drawers built with heavy-duty HDPE, smooth steel ball-bearing slides, and our patented flex-side bands. This design keeps all your spice jars steady, visible, and easy to reach without knocking anything over.
We also have 2-drawer and single-drawer models depending on your cabinet space and container heights.
